scope: Design proposal only; not imported by the game

type.packaging: Local WOFF2 with license notices in stage B; this proposal uses system fallbacks

layout.narrowRule: Keep the primary decision and its costs above the optional details; expose scene objects through a named keyboard-accessible dock

motion.reduced: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and a local preference; remove particles, movement and count interpolation; show final state immediately
motion.ceremony: Optional and skippable; show totals immediately on skip; never change simulation timing or outcomes

audio.unlock: After explicit player interaction; do not autoplay
audio.licenseRule: Record each actual audio file and its exact license before integration

semantics.agency: Current player choice and keyboard focus
semantics.crisis: Danger and severe loss; always paired with text and icon
semantics.achievement: An earned milestone, office or legacy; always paired with text
semantics.partyColors: Fictional groups only; pair with symbols or patterns and labels
semantics.artText: All readable text is HTML or SVG text, never baked into generated art
